title: Writing: My Own Line
label: ch:ja-writing-my-own-line
canDo: I can write one line of Japanese about my day from a closed supply of known words, with nothing to copy, and write every small sign small.

payoff.summary: Complete JA-W143-my-own-line: a time word, a polite verb and a full stop, chosen rather than copied, with the small signs checked before anything else.
payoff.note: The first Japanese writing with nothing to reach for. The Japanese-specific check arrives with it: a small sign is a different sign, not a smaller copy, and a full-size one writes a different word or none.
